name: Clockwork Conundrum (Classic)
summary:
We find ourselves in the skin of Alexis Trueman a young man without aspirations and looking to be someone or something important in life, We are employees of Raymond Storage Co. a company hired by Fazbear Entertainment to make a transfer of important material. We are sent to one of their abandoned warehouses, being in complete solitude we will find out little by little our real purpose
You are in your office where through a PC with an outdated surveillance system you keep you at bay for 4 hours with 3 killer Animatronics of a corrupt company, in the process with your laptop you must remove the files stored in this company in the Animatronicos to give them to the people who hired you that according to is for a local where they will attract another type of Animatronics
